use default

bernoulli(rows: int) -> Pipe[LIST[int]] is
    let row mut = LIST()
    row.add(1)

    for number in 0..rows do
        yield row

        let following = LIST()
        following.add(1)

        for column in 1::row.count - 1 do
            following.add(row[column - 1] + row[column])
        od

        following.add(row[row.count - 1] * 2)

        row = following
    od

for row in bernoulli(15) do
    write_line(row |> map(value => "{value,7}") |> join(""))
